scope.training_clip_selection: The repeatability-only runner replays the same two frozen training-plan clips; these are distinct from the seq2/seq3 real-checkpoint gate clips.

scalar_sdpa_path.setup: Two fresh CPU repeats of bias = fixed_score * zero_initialized_scalar, scaled_dot_product_attention, and the straight-through native identity; one intra-op thread and deterministic algorithms enabled.

single_adapter_layer.setup: Two fresh CPU repeats of the XMemTokenAffinityRoPEAttention implementation with fixed synthetic feature tensors; 64 query tokens, 128 memory tokens, 2 heads, 8-dimensional affinity keys; one intra-op thread and deterministic algorithms enabled.

interpretation: The exact real-clip repeatability gate fails. Per-parameter receipts localize the first observed discrepancy to the layer-0 scalar xmem_strength gradient. The small parameter delta and matching plans do not excuse failure under the frozen exact criterion. Isolated synthetic tests of the scalar-SDPA path and a single adapter layer were exactly repeatable, so they found no defect in those bounded operations; they do not identify the source of the mismatch in the full SAM2 training integration. This is an engineering finding, not a Dice result.
decision: Do not run efficacy training or full-cohort inference. The exact real-clip integration failure remains unresolved; any further diagnostic must be bounded and target intermediate activations/gradients around the layer-0 adapter without changing the frozen method. Keep the earlier stored-mask/native-memory alignment assertion separately unresolved. Do not relax equality or change the efficacy method to obtain a pass.
